image.alt: A yardang field on a hyper-arid desert plateau: dozens of long, low, flat-topped rock ridges lying parallel across the bare ground, with pale wind-swept sand filling the corridors between them and no vegetation in sight
image.caption: Yardangs in the Qaidam Basin, China. Photo: Liuxingy, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
